from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "From Geometry to Formula", 
            [
                "This geometric process is exactly what Bayes' Theorem describes.",
                "The numerator represents the specific shaded Glitch-Spark area.",
                "Dividing by the total shaded area gives the posterior."
            ]
        )
        
        # Colors
        GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR = "#F1C40F"  # Gold as per Section 5 instructions
        FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR = "#3498DB" # Blue for contrast
        EQUATION_COLOR = WHITE
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display the equation P(H|E) = [P(E|H) * P(H)] / P(E) in white (#FFFFFF).
        
        # We break the equation into parts for easier boxing later
        # Part 0: P(H|E) = 
        # Part 1: Numerator (P(E|H)P(H))
        # Part 2: Fraction line
        # Part 3: Denominator (P(E))
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(H|E)", "=", "{P(E|H) P(H)", "\\over", "P(E)}",
            color=EQUATION_COLOR
        )
        
        self.place_in_area(formula, 'C2', 'D5', scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Draw a box around the numerator and point it to the 'True Positive' area.
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR)
        
        # Representative 'True Positive' area (Glitch-Spark)
        # Using a rectangle to mimic the geometric concept
        true_positive_rect = Rectangle(
            width=1.0, height=0.6, 
            fill_color=GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.8, 
            stroke_color=WHITE
        )
        tp_label = Text("Glitch-Spark", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        tp_group = VGroup(true_positive_rect, tp_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(tp_group, 'B3', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Target the numerator specifically in the MathTex
        # formula[2] is P(E|H)P(H)
        num_box = SurroundingRectangle(formula[2], color=GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR, buff=0.1)
        num_arrow = Arrow(
            start=num_box.get_critical_point(UP),
            end=tp_group.get_critical_point(DOWN),
            color=GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR,
            buff=0.1
        )
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(tp_group),
            Create(num_box),
            GrowArrow(num_arrow)
        )
        self.play(Indicate(formula[2], color=GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR))
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Draw a box around the denominator and point it to the 'Total Evidence' area.
        
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR)
        
        # Representative 'Total Evidence' area (Glitch-Spark + False Positives)
        # Showing it as a larger composite rectangle
        total_evidence_rect = VGroup(
            Rectangle(width=1.0, height=0.6, fill_color=GLITCH_SPARK_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.5),
            Rectangle(width=0.5, height=0.6, fill_color=FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR, fill_opacity=0.5)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0)
        total_evidence_rect.set_stroke(WHITE, width=2)
        
        te_label = Text("Total Shaded Area", font_size=18, color=WHITE)
        te_group = VGroup(total_evidence_rect, te_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(te_group, 'E3', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Target the denominator specifically in the MathTex
        # formula[4] is P(E)
        den_box = SurroundingRectangle(formula[4], color=FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR, buff=0.1)
        den_arrow = Arrow(
            start=den_box.get_critical_point(DOWN),
            end=te_group.get_critical_point(UP),
            color=FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR,
            buff=0.1
        )
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(te_group),
            Create(den_box),
            GrowArrow(den_arrow)
        )
        self.play(Indicate(formula[4], color=FALSE_POSITIVE_COLOR))
        self.wait(3)

        # Final state cleanup
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(2)
